# shibumistack.dev

> Source, tests, agent instructions, and VPS deployment config for SQLite full-stack, Bun + Hono markdown blog, and static projects.

## Posts

Every blog post is also available as plain markdown at the `.md` links below.

- [Dogfooding Shibumi](/blog/dogfooding.md): The website found gaps in the CLI and deployment model before release.
- [Two questions and a plan](/blog/two-questions-and-a-plan.md): Create and setup lost seven prompts between them. What is left is two real inputs, a plan you approve once, and one opt-in command.

## Available

- [`create-shibumi`](/docs/cli.md): creates SQLite full-stack apps, Bun + Hono markdown blogs, and static sites with VPS deployment; `bun create shibumi .` adds deployment to an existing project.
- [Extensions](/docs/cli/extensions.md): add bundled auth, email, uploads, or admin source with `bun shi add <name>`.
- [FAQ](/docs/faq.md): why push with a prebuilt image, dirty-tree stops, data across rollbacks, secrets, CSRF 403s, push-to-deploy, template choices.
- [Shibumi Forms](/forms.md): hosted pre-alpha and self-hosted form collection for static sites using plain HTML, Bun, Hono, and SQLite.
- [`shibumi-server`](/server.md): open-source VPS deployment service for exact locally built images, rootless Podman, Caddy, health checks, bounded rollback, and project-owned Ship source.
